purpose: Replace fragmented assistance with one weapon-aware optional swordsmanship policy; preserve user intent, useful preparation, continuity and physical inertia. This is not a strength-percent optimization.
status: Optional candidate evidence; general defaults unchanged. Public delivery is recorded separately by the director.

reproduction.sourceIdentity: Checkout SHA alone is insufficient: uncommitted runtime/tool content is identified by each raw sourceBefore and the frozen snapshot. All 26 main rows used identical src hashes. Later entry-only exclusion of two unstable weapons is outside this physical batch.
reproduction.reference: Qinggang: previous public v2/body B, manual onehand, blade profile, transported thrust, armorCausal finish. Longsword and added spin references: current general legacy 0.7/autoGuard.
reproduction.candidate: Unified entry, manual onehand on melee, same Qinggang physical trial flags; old level/autoGuard replaced by unified controller. Gun remains legacy and excludes drag deltas.
reproduction.input: Fixed differential gesture tape; alive/gun gates match main. Physics-time 120Hz events do not include browser hit-stop, variable-render cadence or emotions. Supplied tape exact does not imply applied live pad remains exact after different generated returns.
reproduction.opponent: Original reactive Heinrich AI with longsword; no park, AI freeze, forced health/state/pose/velocity or seed search.

denominators.note: 26 executions are bounded fixtures and diagnostic comparisons, not 26 independent human trials. Sixteen smoke rows have no force/contact ledger and are not paired efficacy comparisons.

comparisons.meaning: Paired whole-controller comparison. References differ by weapon: Qinggang public v2/body B; other weapons general legacy 0.7. Goals and generated return can intentionally differ.

controllerContracts.syntheticScope: Real Skill filter with synthetic health/command states; these do not count as actual injury/finish/early-abort exposure. Final tests independently calculate gesture projection and check drag-to-ready hand/aim completion.

failuresAndCorrections.failure: Actual drag dead-band residual stranded the ready hand even after the pad reached home.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Generated return now also converges anchor toward off with a limited goal speed while preserving real input-velocity accounting. Final unit passes hand/aim/ready criteria.

failuresAndCorrections.failure: Static review found installation could seed its offset from the first moved raw goal and absorb startup intent.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Initialize the reference at setup through prepareSwordsmanship(0), before input/physics.
failuresAndCorrections.qualification: Two actual first-step rounds after correction are a preliminary diagnostic, not source-frozen whole-game coverage.

independentPlanarProjection.definition: Independently computed from resolved Fighter.handBase and stored raw-hand successive plane displacements. Ordinary moving/player-owned steps only; no use of the controller-reported retainedProjection.

screenEffects.generatedInput: All candidate screen/live/smoke frames: no generated return while held/active, no generated-return new swing/lunge; measured input velocity error below 7e-16 m/s. Legacy ordinary return has no generated ledger field, so its separate 0.01m pad-accounting residual is expected.
screenEffects.jointParameters: Screen k/d/max and arm gains exact between paired controllers. Adaptive leg gains differ after changed motion: Qinggang front51/back8 frames; Longsword front108/back111 frames. Actual forces, native requests, leg control and trajectories are not identical.
screenEffects.interpretation: Qinggang stance intervention is visibly larger in goals, but tracking is not uniformly improved. Stop/reverse residual motion remains and is not ranked solely by low error or fast stopping.

tapBoundaries.definition: Fighter.handBase is an underlying pre-thrust base. At full explicit command weight, that base can change while the final resolved hand/world target remains continuous. Do not label the 188/200mm hidden-base handover as a physical or final-goal teleport.

liveCoverage.limits: Actual contact, wounds, pain and getup occurred. New reactive enemy inputs and collision histories diverge; lower wounds/getup time is not injury-prevention or victory evidence. Strong main-arm injury, finish command and early abort were not exposed in candidate live rows.

largestPerCandidate.interpretation: Prior collision raises pain; the following controller step withdraws optional direct yaw. This is a requested-angle change, not a native transform overwrite or proof of naturalness.

weaponExclusions.decision: Do not publish unified entry for monohoshizao or lightsaber; internal morgenstern remains unpublished. Public roster is 13 choices: 12 supported melee plus pistol legacy/no-op.
weaponExclusions.interpretation: Severe axial rotation occurs in both old reference and candidate before the first drag. Candidate does not solve it and mixed measures include worsening. Finite-state fixture PASS is not normal-motion acceptance.
weaponExclusions.gun: Pistol installer false and applied hand drag zero; no swordsmanship benefit claimed.
weaponExclusions.smokeLimits: Only a short 5.9s compatibility tape. All-weapon long combat, naturalness, performance and physical-phone Safari are not certified.

reuse.existingForceLedger: Unchanged read observers reused; no redundant old-ledger calibration replay. New observer noninterference was not separately replay-verified in this batch.
reuse.legacyFinishRule: Existing finish-rule unit evidence may be reused for the unchanged rule; it does not cover new-controller live finish handover.
reuse.priorLive: Previous v2 live getup/death traces are historical context only; new-controller actual exposure comes from live-run03.
reuse.requiredRegressionAndBrowser: Director records current six regressions, local/mobile browser and public delivery separately; not asserted by this JSON.
